title: Escape phenomenon of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol during lovastatin treatment.
abstract: The main issue is whether briefly stopping treatment of the hypercholesterolemic patient will accelerate the atherosclerotic process. This is possible, but such a strategy is preferable only in a subgroup of patients who cannot bear the economic burden of increasing the dosage of statins. In addition, stopping and restarting the drug at different stages lessens the likelihood of more adverse effects occurring when the dosage is increased.
